dct_description_sm: Funded by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) Atlantic Ecosystems Initiatives (AEI), the Miramichi River Environmental Assessment Committee (MREAC) sampled for nutrients, Total Nitrogen and Total Phosphorus, and bacteria, Escherichia coli (E. coli) on the Miramichi Watershed in 2020.
dct_title_s: Miramichi River Environmental Assessment Committee (MREAC) Atlantic Ecosystems Initiatives (AEI) Nutrient and Bacteria Sampling on the Miramichi Watershed 2020
